company_description:
Welcome to Emissary Cafe & Coffeehouse in the heart of Coconut Grove, 
Miami! Experience our commitment to local, seasonal ingredients, premium 
coffee and espresso from roasters Counter Culture and Pergamino, and 
authentic hospitality. Our bright, airy, friendly, and open space is 
created for you and the community, and welcomes everyone, of all 
backgrounds and beliefs.
